issues.description: Active filter badge for category was removed but filter still exists
issues.detail: The `category__in` entry was deleted from `DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES` in active-filter-badge.tsx while the Category filter was simultaneously added to findings-filters.tsx. Users selecting category filters will no longer see an active badge indicating the filter is applied, breaking parity with all other filters and making it hard to clear.

issues.description: Badge label uses formatted display label instead of raw value, breaking de-selection
issues.detail: In data-table-filter-custom.tsx, `badgeLabel={getBadgeLabel(entity, displayLabel)}` now passes the human-readable label instead of the raw value. If `getBadgeLabel` or downstream selection logic keys on the value (e.g. to identify the option being toggled off), this can desynchronize the badge from the underlying filter value `iam` vs `IAM`.

issues.description: Short-word acronym heuristic mislabels common 3-letter words
issues.detail: `formatWord` upper-cases any word with length <= 3, so legitimate categories like "new", "old", "web", "dev", "key" become "NEW", "WEB", "KEY". Since the old explicit mapping was removed, any future category ID containing such a word will render incorrectly with no way to override beyond editing `SPECIAL_CASES`.

issues.description: Removed CATEGORY_IDS export may break external consumers
issues.detail: The old adapter exported `CategoryId` type and `CATEGORY_IDS` const. The replacement `lib/categories.ts` only exports `getCategoryLabel`. Any imports of `CategoryId` from `risk-radar.adapter` elsewhere in the codebase will now fail to compile. The diff doesn't show those callers being updated.

issues.description: Duplicate severity key with same value adds noise
issues.detail: Adding `Info: 4` alongside `Informational: 4` in SEVERITY_ORDER works but invites drift if one is updated and the other isn't. Prefer normalizing the input at the boundary (map "Info" -> "Informational") rather than carrying two synonyms in the ordering table.

issues.description: CategorySelector handles empty-string value that Select never emits
issues.detail: `handleValueChange` treats `value === ""` as clearing selection, but the underlying Select only emits "all" or a categoryId. The empty-string branch is dead code; either remove it or document why it's defensive. Also, since SelectValue placeholder is unreachable (value is always set), the placeholder is dead.

review.summary: The PR cleanly extracts category label formatting into a shared lib and wires up a Risk Radar component, but introduces a few regressions worth addressing before merge. The most important: the active-filter badge for `category__in` was deleted while the category filter was added to findings, leaving users without a visible/clearable active-filter chip. The new heuristic-based `getCategoryLabel` is more flexible than the old explicit map but will mislabel any 3-letter English word as an acronym (e.g. \"new\" -> \"NEW\"). Smaller concerns: the badge label now uses display text rather than raw value (potential desync), the removed `CATEGORY_IDS`/`CategoryId` exports could break other importers, and the duplicate `Info`/`Informational` keys in SEVERITY_ORDER are better normalized at the input boundary.
